executive_email.subject: Claude Enterprise for Notion's AWS roadmap
executive_email.body:
Hi Kavya,

I noticed Notion is investing in AWS — Growing investment in enterprise LLM applications. Teams with a similar footprint have used Claude Enterprise to accelerate that roadmap while keeping governance intact.

Lead with Claude Enterprise outcomes — anchor on their announced AWS initiatives.

Open to a 20-minute conversation this week?

Best,
Anthropic Account Team

linkedin_message.to: Priya Bose · Head of Cloud Platform
linkedin_message.body: Hi Priya — saw Notion's momentum around AWS. We're helping similar teams ship Claude Enterprise use cases in weeks, not quarters. Worth a quick chat?

call_script.opening: Reference Notion's AWS initiative and the signal: Growing investment in enterprise LLM applications.
discovery_questions: How is the team prioritizing Claude Enterprise this quarter?
What would block a AWS rollout — data residency and compliance requirements?
call_script.close: Propose a scoped proof-of-value with success criteria.

companies.next_best_action: Book discovery call with the Notion platform team
